r19-001.gate_key: conj_b2 | B2.1 | mcq | Choose the correct option: My partner loves late nights, ___ I'm at my best early in the morning. | whereas

item.q: Choose the correct option: My partner loves late nights, ___ I'm at my best early in the morning.
item.why: *whereas* + subject + verb puts two different facts side by side; it usually stands in the middle. *despite*, *due to* and *instead of* need a noun or *-ing*, not a whole clause.
item.why_lv: *whereas* + teikuma priekšmets + darbības vārds nostāda blakus divus atšķirīgus faktus; parasti tas ir teikuma vidū. Aiz *despite*, *due to* un *instead of* vajag lietvārdu vai *-ing*, nevis veselu teikumu.
